spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.topic: absent 16:00-NY flat bar: NO_TRADE vs early_forced_flat fallback
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.conflict: The mission prompt states 'if the 16:00-NY bar is absent on entry day, NO_TRADE' (twice), but the frozen proposal clocks.forced_flat defines the fallback: exit at the OPEN of the immediately preceding existing H1 bar, recorded as early_forced_flat; A9-F executed 70 such events and selection was granted on that basis.
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.resolution: PROPOSAL VERBATIM: early_forced_flat fallback implemented; additionally the prompt's stricter intent is enforced where it is compatible - an entry is never committed without a flat exit available that day (fallback bar must exist after the entry slot, else NO_TRADE, reason flat_exit_unavailable). Prompt's literal 'absent bar => NO_TRADE' is treated as describing the no-fallback-available case.
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.impact: ~15 real-snapshot anchor trades kept (would be dropped under the prompt-literal reading); exit_reason enum stays {invalidation, forced_flat} per the module API; early events identifiable by exit_ts < 16:00-NY instant.

spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.topic: weekly governor partition: [Mon 00:00Z UTC) vs Sun 21:00 America/New_York
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.conflict: Frozen proposal trade_budget_governor defines the UTC week as [Monday 00:00Z, next Monday 00:00Z); the mission prompt describes the running week as 'Sun21:00NY-based'.
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.resolution: PROPOSAL definition implemented ([Mon 00:00Z)). Provably equivalent here: all entries occur at 10-12Z (observed; structurally >= 10Z) so no entry ever falls in [Mon 00:00Z, Mon 01/02:00Z) where the two partitions differ.

spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.conflict: minimum_decisions says 'one state-valid UTC day on which the arm's schedule completed a first-break trigger evaluation (go or no-go)'; A9-F's 'decisions_compressed_total' counts only compression-state days (min 93/pair/fold vs floor 80).
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.resolution: Compressed-state days counted (state computable AND compression true AND London window complete AND trigger evaluation completed go or no-go; void entries included). Matches A9-F's floor arithmetic (93 vs 80) and makes the floor binding; all-days counting would make the floor vacuous (~500/pair/fold).

spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.topic: bar universe on the overlap of the Tokyo window with the London window (A9-F A4P1-2) and weekend/holiday provider bars (A4P1-3/X2)
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.conflict: In BST the London window starts 07:00Z, inside the Tokyo UTC window [00:00,09:00); such bars can never strictly breach their own range extremes (dead bars). Separately, the provider emits convention-out-of-session bars (early-Monday pre-open, and full weekend coverage from 2026-01), and the spec pins no filter.
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.resolution: VERBATIM consumption of canonical td_loader rows with NO session filtering; session validity strictly by all-9/all-4 slot existence (fail-closed); dead bars accepted (deterministic: they cannot fire the anchor trigger; the control M-trigger can fire on them by construction).
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.impact: Weekend sessions (2026-01 onward provider coverage change) produce valid states: 151 anchor / 142 neighbour / 394 control weekend trades and Sat/Sun decision days. Every UTC weekday Mon-Fri appears among decision days (concentration_plan satisfied); weekend days are additional. Flagged for A7: if the owner wants weekend bars excluded, that is an owner-side frozen amendment (data authority), not a family repair.

spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.topic: both-breaches exact tie on a trigger bar
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.conflict: break_test: 'exact tie => no trade' - ambiguous whether scanning stops for the day or continues.
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.resolution: The tie bar yields no decision; the scan CONTINUES with later window bars (the day's first QUALIFYING break can still produce the decision).
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.impact: deterministic; exercised on real data via control-arm dead bars (close == M)

spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.conflict: 'within the trailing 30 calendar days' does not pin inclusivity.
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.resolution: Window = [D-30, D): session dates D' with D-30 <= D' < D, most recent 20 taken when more exist.

spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.topic: invalidation exit whose next-H1 fill slot is missing
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.conflict: missing_bar_rule: 'NO_TRADE (or earliest-available scheduled exit for forced-flat only)' - a post-entry missing fill slot cannot mean NO_TRADE (the position already exists and the guaranteed forced-flat exit remains).
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.resolution: The unfilled invalidation event is skipped and the scan continues (a later fillable invalidation exits there); if none, the trade rides to the guaranteed forced-flat exit (verified to exist BEFORE entry). Never a fabricated fill; never past the rollover.
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.impact: 0 occurrences on the real snapshot (entry_bar_missing = flat_exit_unavailable = 0; all invalidation fills resolved)

spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.topic: tier-2.0 delayed exit beyond the flat rule
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.conflict: 'exit similarly shifted, still bounded by forced-flat; if a delayed fill cannot happen before the flat rule, NO_TRADE' - an exit cannot be NO_TRADE after entry.
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.resolution: NO_TRADE applies to the delayed ENTRY (missing or at/after flat => void, reason entry_not_before_forced_flat / entry_bar_missing); the delayed EXIT is bounded to the forced-flat instant (reason degrades to forced_flat when the bounding applies).
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.impact: hand-verified in test_13; tier-2 exits never cross the flat rule

spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.conflict: Module API names decision_ts without defining it.
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.resolution: decision_ts = the bar-open stamp of the decision bar (the bar whose break_test fired) - the identifiable trigger event; entry_ts = next allowed H1 open (one-event lag), exit per the frozen laws.
spec_ambiguities_resolved_for_a7_review.impact: informational field; fold attribution in scoring uses entry/exit instants
